name: Serantis Battle, Moves and Spawning
description: Creature battle stats from the Serantis stat sheet, a Level 20 cap, and Serantis spawn odds: 70% Common, 15% Uncommon, 10% Rare, 4% Super Rare, 1% Legendary, with a 1% chance of any spawn being Mutated. Every creature fights with 3 moves from the Serantis Move Dex.
